name: 粉雾盈润便携护手霜款
description: 雾粉暖调秋冬护手霜套图：滋润便携、清爽不粘腻、膏体饱满的转化链路

styleLock.direction: soft pink autumn-winter hand care commerce
styleLock.backgroundSystem: two-tone mist pink #F7C6D0 with a deeper coral band #E8899B for hero shots, clean white #FFFFFF and warm greige #F4F1EE for info shots, seamless coral #E8637B for the closing shot
styleLock.lightingSystem: warm soft studio lighting, gentle front or front-left key, soft contact shadows, controlled highlights, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte round podium, smooth seamless paper backdrops and a light grey matte board #F5F4F2
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, rounded capsule labels, short headers only
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons and numbered circles in a single coral accent #E8637B
styleLock.presentationRules: stable upright tube at a slight 3/4 or straight-on hero angle, consistent scale across the set
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent soft pink autumn-winter hand care visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of mist pink background #F7C6D0, coral red accent #E8637B, clean white #FFFFFF and charcoal text #3B3B3D; warm soft studio lighting with a gentle front key and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif with rounded capsule labels; consistent thin-line icon style; clean high-end hand-cream photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable upright tube presentation at a consistent hero angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 首屏以雾粉圆台立体主图赢取点击，确立套图色调
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, tube standing upright and centered on a round podium, full product visible
shots.lighting: warm soft studio lighting, gentle front key, soft contact shadow grounding the tube, controlled highlight on the shoulder
shots.background: two-tone mist pink seamless backdrop, lighter #F7C6D0 upper field into a deeper coral pink band #E8899B
shots.props: one or two blurred matte spheres in soft pink, kept away from the product
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace; the podium and backdrop fill the frame
shots.promptTemplate: Product hero photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on eye-level view, the tube standing upright and centered on a round matte podium, full product visible. Warm soft studio lighting with a gentle front key and a soft contact shadow grounding the tube, one controlled highlight on the shoulder. Two-tone mist pink seamless backdrop, lighter #F7C6D0 upper field flowing into a deeper coral pink band #E8899B, with one or two blurred matte spheres as quiet props. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame. No extra whitespace; the podium and backdrop fill the frame. 2K commercial beauty e-commerce quality. Negative: no brand wordmarks or logos on the backdrop or tube surroundings, no in-image text, no QR code, no membership badge, no invented efficacy claims, no cut-off edges, no floating product without contact shadow.

shots.intent: 一秒传达滋润补水的核心利益，承接首屏
shots.camera: slight 3/4 angle, tube upright on the right third of the frame
shots.lighting: soft front-left key light, gentle contact shadow, no harsh speculars
shots.background: clean white #FFFFFF lower field with a soft mist pink #F7C6D0 top band
shots.props: one blurred matte sphere in the top band
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace; the capsule bar and product anchor the layout
shots.textZone: top coral capsule bar divided into three rounded segments
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Slight 3/4 angle, the tube upright on the right third of the frame. Clean white #FFFFFF lower field with a soft mist pink #F7C6D0 top band; a coral red #E8637B rounded capsule bar spans the upper area, divided into three segments reading 「{selling_point_1}」「{selling_point_2}」「{selling_point_3}」 in clean white #FFFFFF lettering, one short phrase per segment. Soft front-left key light with a gentle contact shadow. The product occupies 50-60% of the frame. No extra whitespace; the capsule bar and product anchor the layout. Negative: no more than three label segments, no dense body text, no fabricated percentages or efficacy claims, no watermark, no fake logo, no props covering the product.

shots.intent: 放大干燥粗糙等手部困扰，制造问题共鸣
shots.camera: flat lay photographed from directly above at a 90-degree overhead angle, three tiles in a staggered grid
shots.lighting: even soft diffused lighting, no harsh shadow, documentary neutral tone
shots.props: three rounded square tiles with abstract hand-skin crops
shots.whitespace: modest even margins between tiles act as breathing whitespace
shots.textZone: small dot-and-line labels placed beside each tile
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point grid for {product}, flat lay photographed from directly above at a 90-degree overhead angle. Three rounded square tiles on a warm greige board #F4F1EE, each tile a tight abstract crop of a hand-skin concern such as rough texture, dry flakiness or fine lines, hands cropped at the wrist with no faces, plus the tube waiting at the edge as the resolution. Small dot-and-line labels beside the tiles reading 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」 in charcoal #3B3B3D. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even soft diffused lighting, no harsh shadow. The tiles occupy 40-50% of the frame overall. Modest even margins between tiles act as breathing whitespace. Negative: no real model face, no exaggerated wounds or diseased skin, no fabricated statistics or percentages, no invented claims, no extra text, no watermark.

shots.intent: 代入随身携带的真实场景，强化小巧便携
shots.camera: eye-level side profile with a candid handheld framing feel
shots.lighting: soft warm window light from the left around 5500K, gentle shadows, soft contact shadow under the tube
shots.background: warm beige linen desk surface #EFE6DC with soft depth blur behind
shots.props: an open canvas tote, a folded knit glove and a small metal key ring, none covering the product
shots.whitespace: generous negative space across the top quarter of the frame
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene of {product} slipped halfway out of an open canvas tote on a warm beige linen desk #EFE6DC, beside a folded knit glove and a small metal key ring, reading as small and pocketable. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from an eye-level side profile with a candid handheld framing feel. Soft warm window light from the left around 5500K, gentle shadows and a soft contact shadow under the tube. Props: an open canvas tote, a folded knit glove and a small metal key ring, none covering the product. The product occupies 40-50% of the frame. Generous negative space across the top quarter of the frame. Negative: no visible face, no hands covering the product, no clutter, no brand marks on props, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 用膏体质地微距证明滋润不粘腻的品质感
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro, tight zoom on the cream swatch, shallow depth of field with the foreground sharp
shots.lighting: skimming side light from the right revealing fine creamy ridges, controlled highlight, soft falloff
shots.background: soft blush pink seamless paper #F9E0E6 melting out of focus
shots.whitespace: minimal; the texture is the whole subject
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of a rich cream swatch scooped from {product}, tight zoom on the glossy swirled texture with one soft peak. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Macro lens at shallow depth of field, foreground sharp, background melting away. Skimming side light from the right revealing fine creamy ridges and a gentle sheen, controlled highlight, soft falloff. Soft blush pink seamless paper background #F9E0E6. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame. Minimal whitespace; the texture is the whole subject. Negative: no blurry subject, no plastic or waxy look, no bubbles or debris, no invented ingredient claims, no extra text, no watermark, no hands or fingers.

shots.intent: 以留空成分卡讲清配方故事，消除成分疑虑
shots.camera: high 45-degree angle looking down over a tidy flat-lay layout
shots.lighting: even high-key flat lighting, no dramatic shadows
shots.props: three rounded white #FFFFFF info cards and one thin coral divider line
shots.whitespace: narrow even margins, no extra whitespace
shots.textZone: right card stack headers and blank bullet lines
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce ingredient-layout infographic for {product}, photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down over a tidy flat-lay. The tube lies upright on the left of a light grey matte board #F5F4F2, and three rounded white #FFFFFF info cards stack on the right, each card carrying a short header 「{callout_4}」 above two deliberately empty bullet lines left blank as proof placeholders, separated by one thin coral #E8637B divider. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even high-key flat lighting, no dramatic shadows. The product and cards occupy 50-60% of the frame. Narrow even margins, no extra whitespace. Negative: no percentages or concentration numbers, no invented ingredient efficacy claims, no dense body text, no fake certification marks, no unreadable tiny text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 以留空测评位与四步用法降去除使用疑虑，建立信任
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level with a structured two-band layout
shots.lighting: even clean studio lighting, soft contact shadows, no dramatic contrast
shots.background: clean white #FFFFFF with a faint warm pink #FBEDEF lower band
shots.props: three rounded experience cards and a four-step numbered strip with cropped hands-only frames
shots.whitespace: clean equal gutters between cards act as whitespace
shots.textZone: card headers in the upper band and numbered step labels in the lower strip
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust and usage screen for {product}, straight-on eye-level with a structured two-band layout on clean white #FFFFFF and a faint warm pink #FBEDEF lower band. Upper band: three rounded experience cards with short headers 「{callout_5}」「{callout_6}」「{callout_7}」 and empty rating slots left blank as proof placeholders. Lower band: a four-step application strip with numbered circles in coral #E8637B showing cropped hands-only frames massaging cream into the back of the hand, wrists cropped, no faces. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even clean studio lighting, soft contact shadows, no dramatic contrast. The layout occupies 50-60% of the frame. Clean equal gutters between cards act as whitespace. Negative: do NOT invent test data, ratings, scores or certifications, no fabricated before-after results, no QR code, no membership badge, no third-party character marks or trademark graphics, no extra text, no watermark.

shots.intent: 珊瑚色收口促单，用行动按钮完成转化闭环

shots.lighting: warm punchy studio light with a gentle top highlight and soft contact shadow
shots.background: seamless coral red #E8637B field with a soft radial glow behind the product
shots.props: one small matte sphere in soft pink
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace; the button and product anchor the composition
shots.textZone: rounded capsule button below the product plus one short sub-badge
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce closing promo of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Slight 3/4 angle, the tube standing upright front and center on a seamless coral red #E8637B field with a soft radial glow behind it, one small matte sphere in soft pink as a quiet prop. Warm punchy studio light with a gentle top highlight and a soft contact shadow. A rounded capsule CTA button in white #FFFFFF sits below the product reading 「{callout_8}」 with one short sub-badge 「{callout_9}」. The product occupies 55-60% of the frame. No extra whitespace; the button and product anchor the composition. Negative: no invented discounts, prices or countdowns, no fabricated claims, no QR code, no membership badge, no extra text beyond the two placeholder slots, no watermark, no fake logo.

provenance.notes: 逐屏事实：P1 雾粉背景圆台上立一支粉色软管护手霜，管身有英文品牌字与容量字样及功效英文短句；P2 珊瑚胶囊条载三个卖点短语与手部困扰标题；P3 燥、皱两类痛点标签与粉底口号区；P4 成分宣称文案与「核心功效含量14.5%」数值；P5-6 透明质酸钠、马脂、甘油、泛醇尿素、积雪草苷等成分块（配图多为灰色空占位）；P7 橘果皮油香氛描述、使用测评三栏、使用方法四步图文及角落会员角标与二维码；P8 四步按摩用法文字与二维码。品类判定：软管护手霜、手部涂抹、膏体特写与手部按摩用法为硬证据，判护肤个护/身体护理，与源夹名一致，无需改判。已剥离：管身品牌字标与系列英文字、原文案原句、功效断言与全部数值（14.5%、10X 类）、香氛来源宣称、测评与检测数据、会员角标与二维码，产品一律以 {product} 占位，功效与卖点改为 {selling_point_n}/{callout_n} 留空位。
